How to add new project photos

  1. Place the image file inside the relevant project folder, such as dist/assets/projects/women-wellbeing-bhimdhunga/.
  2. Use JPG, PNG, or WebP files for the web.
  3. Replace the placeholder SVG in the gallery card with the final image path, for example ../assets/projects/women-wellbeing-bhimdhunga/clinic-1.jpg.
  4. Commit and push the changes to GitHub to publish them.
